summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of KINTRACK. 29/29 pytest backend tests passed covering auth, indicators (17 seeded), officers CRUD, periods (15 seeded, lock toggle), data-entry validation for percentage (negative denom, num>den, zero-denom→N/A), calculation correctness (percentage 950/1000→95.0, composite IP ASN 1.14→85.75, manual 1.17), append-only calculation history, recalculate-all, workflow draft→submitted→verified→approved→locked, RBAC (viewer 403 on writes), users mgmt + cannot delete self, mappings CRUD, SIPP sync returns 501, business-rules, survey questions, audit logs, dashboard shape+counts=17. Frontend Playwright: login OK, dashboard renders (17 total / 2 tercapai / 1 belum / 14 belum-dihitung, charts + KPI table), all 10 nav pages load with no errors, Tambah Indikator dialog opens, dynamic Input Data form shows numerator/denominator for percentage indicator 1.2, Simpan & Hitung produced result 95%, target 100, gap -5, status BELUM TERCAPAI, approval timeline visible, Ajukan (advance) clicked successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: Officer dashboard filter uses db.responsible_officers.find({'active': True}) but the OfficerReq schema stores field 'active'; consistency OK. However responsible_officers seed should be checked to include 'active':True.
compute_gap uses result - target only; for indicators where lower-is-better (target_operator '<='), gap sign may be misleading in reports. Not blocking.
seed_all runs on every startup; ensure it is idempotent (create_indicator uses unique code so likely OK). Not verified in this iteration.
recalculate_all uses query param without validation; if period_id missing FastAPI returns 422 which is fine but consider explicit 400 message.
server.py is ~820 lines — could be split into routers (auth/indicators/data/dashboard/users) for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
seed_data_creation: Tests created some TEST_ prefixed data (indicator TEST_9.99, officer TEST999, viewer test_viewer_<ts>@example.com) and cleaned them up. Also created real data entries for indicators 1.1, 1.14, 1.17, 1.2 in an Open 2025/2026 period — these populate the calculations collection with valid history. Advance workflow test locked one entry (1.17) fully to 'locked' status.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully validated via pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_kintrack_backend.py. Frontend selectors confirmed: login-username-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, nav-*-link, add-indicator-button, select-indicator, select-period, input-numerator, input-denominator, input-data-save-button, input-data-calculate-button, approval-advance-button (rendered as 'Ajukan'). Some indicator entries have been advanced through workflow — reset if needed. Indicator 1.17 entry may already be at 'locked' status. No SIPP integration (returns 501 by design).
